# aibris v0.14.1

This patch release keeps cache cleanup inside the previewed target, makes
piped answers and execution receipts reliable, and fixes the root help text.
It contains only fixes to existing behavior.

## Highlights

- **Go cache cleanup no longer runs `go`** (#605, #610).
  - aibris removes the verified Go build cache through its deletion gate, the
    same route as npm and Homebrew. Cleanup therefore writes no Go telemetry
    counters outside the cache, never triggers a telemetry upload, and never
    selects or downloads a toolchain.
  - A directory counts as a Go cache only when every top-level entry is one
    Go creates (`README`, `trim.txt`, `testexpire.txt`, `log.txt`, `fuzz`,
    two-hex-digit buckets) or Finder's `.DS_Store`.
  - A `GOCACHE` taken from the environment or the `GOENV` file must also carry
    Go's own `README` signature.
  - These checks protect a user who once pointed `GOCACHE` at a shared
    directory. That directory is never a target, even when it holds a genuine
    Go `README`, and the checks repeat right before removal.
- **npm cleanup stays inside `_cacache`** (#605). npm's cache is removed
  through the deletion gate instead of `npm cache clean --force`, which wrote
  logs next to the previewed target.
- **Preview matches execution for symlinked caches** (#611).
  - A catalog cache whose leaf is a symlink (Go, npm, Homebrew) is shown as
    skipped, with `cache_leaf_symlink` in JSON, and its bytes are left out of
    the selected total.
  - Execution already refused it. Before, the dry-run counted it as selected.
- **Piped answers reach the right prompt** (#606). All prompts in one `clean`
  run share one stdin reader, so scripted answers piped through guided review
  and the final or per-item confirmation are no longer lost. Ctrl-C still
  stops the run promptly.
- **Guided receipts keep their evidence** (#603).
  - Guided execution receipts use the identity captured before confirmation.
  - Before, a target behind a symlinked path that vanished during confirmation
    could drop the receipt for targets that were already removed.
  - An internal identity error after a removal now keeps the receipt. It
    reports `partial_failure` only when something was actually reclaimed.
- **Root help lists Grok** among agent-state providers. The list now comes
  from the provider registry (#607).

## Compatibility impact

- [x] **Compatible addition.**
  - New receipt reason code `execution_identity_invalid`. It appears only on
    an internal invariant failure.
  - Dry-run plans may now report `cache_leaf_symlink`, a reason code that
    receipts already used.
  - No flag, field, or enum value was removed or renamed, and
    `schema_version` stays `1`.
  - Valid guided receipts are byte-identical to v0.14.0.

## Upgrade and migration

No flag migration is required.

```bash
brew upgrade aibris
# or (Unix):
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sungjunlee/aibris/refs/heads/main/install.sh | bash -s -- v0.14.1
# or (Windows PowerShell):
irm https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sungjunlee/aibris/refs/heads/main/install.ps1 | iex
```

- A last-scan cache written by v0.14.0 still records the old Go and npm
  cleanup commands. `clean` refuses those cached targets with
  `cleanup_recipe_changed`; run `aibris scan` (or a live `clean`) once to
  refresh.
- Go cache cleanup now removes the whole cache directory, including the fuzz
  cache, which the reported size already counted.
  - `go clean -cache` kept the fuzz cache and the top directory.
  - Go recreates the cache on next use with default permissions. Custom
    permissions on the cache root are not kept.

## Safety

- Every earlier safeguard is unchanged: the single deletion gate, dry-run and
  confirmation, `--risky`, active-worktree protection, agent-state proof and
  grace, re-verification at the mutation boundary, and overlap safety.
- Cache cleanup no longer starts any package-manager process except
  `uv cache clean`, which runs with its cache pinned to the verified target.
- Fail-closed narrowing:
  - A Go cache directory with any other top-level entry is no longer a
    target.
  - A symlinked cache leaf is no longer counted as selected.
- Known limitations, tracked for follow-up:
  - An excluded Go cache is omitted without an explanation row.
  - The Go layout check reads only the top level.
  - Windows junction cache leaves and some cleaner command tests on Windows
    are not yet covered (#611, #602).

## Windows status

Unchanged from v0.14.0. Native Windows CI runs the full `internal/safedelete`,
`internal/pathidentity`, and `internal/testutil` packages and the production
PowerShell installer tests. Real vendor agent worktree layouts on Windows,
end-to-end delete mutation, and native arm64 execution remain experimental
and unmeasured. See `docs/WINDOWS.md`.
